description: Lists the basemaps in Make with MapLibre (makewithmaplibre.com): ready-made MapLibre styles from OpenFreeMap, Protomaps, MapTiler, Stadia Maps, VersaTiles and others, with their style URLs and whether they need an API key, plus raster and elevation tiles. Pass a style URL as url to render_style or compare_styles to see it, or start a style from it.

free.description: true for only the basemaps that need no API key, false for only those that do.

query.description: Words that each basemap has to contain, in its name, provider or description, like "dark", "satellite" or "openfreemap".

name: find_basemaps
title: Find basemaps
